user.title: Grid capacity charge Austria
user.description: Select the grid import energy meter (kWh, total/total_increasing). A live grid import power sensor (W/kW) is optional and improves the forecast. Draft regulation (SNE-G-V), prices are indicative only — the network operator's meter is authoritative.

data_description.energy_entity: Cumulative meter reading of grid import in Wh, kWh or MWh.
data_description.power_entity: Current grid import in W or kW; negative values (export) count as 0.

error.invalid_energy_unit: The energy sensor must use Wh, kWh or MWh.
error.invalid_state_class: The energy sensor must have state_class total or total_increasing.
error.invalid_power_unit: The power sensor must use W or kW.

abort.already_configured: This energy sensor is already configured.

init.title: Thresholds and prices
init.description: Default prices are indicative values (not official); the tariff regulation is still pending. Energy prices of 0 mean 'not set'.

data_description.tier_limit_kw: Up to and including this value tier 1 applies, above it tier 2 (grid level 7: 10 kW).
data_description.agreed_kw: Contractually agreed grid capacity; existing connections count as 10 kW.
data_description.minimum_kw: At least this much is billed; also at least 20 % of the agreed capacity.
data_description.plausibility_kw: 15-minute averages above this value are treated as measurement errors.
data_description.hysteresis_kw: 'Peak imminent' switches off only when the forecast falls this far below the target.

error.hysteresis_too_large: Hysteresis must be smaller than the target power.
error.target_above_plausibility: Target power must not exceed the plausibility limit.
